498.text: the Church which I had always regarded as the simplest acts

311.text: the heavy grey face of the paralytic

382.text: a packet of High Toast for him and this present

quotes.text: “I am not long for this world,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“No, I wouldn’t say he was exactly ... but there was something
queer ... there was something uncanny about him. I’ll tell you my
opinion....”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I have my own theory about it,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“I think it was one of
those ... peculiar cases.... But it’s hard to say....”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Well, so your old friend is gone, you’ll be sorry to hear.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Who?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Father Flynn.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Is he dead?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Mr Cotter here has just told us. He was passing by the house.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“The youngster and he were great friends. The old chap taught him a
great deal, mind you; and they say he had a great wish for him.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “God have mercy on his soul,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I wouldn’t like children of mine,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“to have too much
to say to a man like that.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “How do you mean, Mr Cotter?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “What I mean is,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“it’s bad for children. My
idea is: let a young lad run about and play with young lads of his own
age and not be.... Am I right, Jack?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “That’s my principle, too,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Let him learn to box
his corner. That’s what I’m always saying to that Rosicrucian there:
take exercise. Why, when I was a nipper every morning of my life I had
a cold bath, winter and summer. And that’s what stands to me now.
Education is all very fine and large.... Mr Cotter might take a pick of
that leg mutton,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “No, no, not for me,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “But why do you think it’s not good for children, Mr Cotter?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “It’s bad for children,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“because their minds
are so impressionable. When children see things like that, you know, it
has an effect....”
quotes.speaker: Unknown
